tips.text: Join a clan that already has the Chem Lab and the Ignis researched, and skip the stacked 72-hour research timers.
Start the Detonite Injector research first, since it unlocks the Ignis research, and farm Ampules while the timers run.
Re-buy the Detonite Injector blueprint for each Injector you craft; it is consumed every time.
Queue Injectors in the Foundry alongside your daily Forma builds instead of waiting.
Nobody complains about the farm; the grumbles are about the stacked research timers.
